title: Loceng Basikal Mak Bidan
genre: Kristang branyo (Portuguese Settlement Melaka folk dance song)
subject: an old bidan in the Melaka Portuguese Settlement who cycles to every birth and is paid only in kuih, so her pantry now holds forty-one tins
caption: Melaka Portuguese-Eurasian branyo folk dance, lively 6/8-feeling two-step. Fiddle playing a bouncing dance melody, acoustic nylon guitar strumming, banjo-like cavaquinho picking offbeats, rebana frame drum with a light shaker, upright bass pulse. Courtyard room sound, live acoustic ensemble. Female alto lead, bright and storytelling, with a mixed group repeating the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 124 BPM, D major. Jolly, boastful, communal mood. No electronic drums, no synthesizers, no autotune, no rap, no electric guitar solos, no reggae or ska backbeat.
lyrics:
[Intro - fiddle, cavaquinho, rebana]

[Verse 1]
Ting ting ting, loceng basikal Mak Bidan
Tengah malam gelap, dia kayuh laju
Beg hitam di bakul, tuala di bahu
Anak mana lagi nak keluar malam ni

[Pre-Chorus]
Ibu tarik nafas, ayah gigit kuku
Mak Bidan kata, sabar, saya ada

[Chorus]
Ting ting ting, anak dah sampai
Tangis pertama, kita semua senyum
Bayaran Mak Bidan bukan duit sen
Sebiji kuih, sebiji kuih, penuh tin

[Verse 2]
Empat puluh satu tin dalam almari
Kuih bahulu, kuih tart, kuih kapit
Ada yang keras, ada yang dah lembap
Tapi Mak Bidan makan, dia tak pernah tolak

[Pre-Chorus]
Budak yang dulu dia sambut, dah besar
Sekarang dia menari depan pentas

[Chorus]
Ting ting ting, anak dah sampai
Tangis pertama, kita semua senyum
Bayaran Mak Bidan bukan duit sen
Sebiji kuih, sebiji kuih, buka tin

[Bridge - fiddle and rebana only]
Kayuh lagi, Mak Bidan, jalan masih jauh
Ada rumah lain, lampu dah menyala

[Outro - fiddle, cavaquinho, group clap]
Ting ting ting, loceng basikal Mak Bidan
Ting ting ting, tin baru dah menunggu
